entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Plants are classes that can be shot down/driven over, and then re-grow after a period of time.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [GameObjectClass] canDetect = false canInteract = false canCollide = false

entries.label: standUp
entries.text: If true, forces it to be straight up, otherwise aligns up perpendicular to Terrain.

entries.label: TransparentGrow
entries.text: If true, Top of growth is transparent.

entries.label: TransparentFall
entries.text: If true, Fall fades to transparent after it falls.

entries.label: TransparentBurn
entries.text: If true, top of Burn is transparent.

entries.label: deadTime
entries.text: How long it stays Dead before regrowing.

entries.label: growTime
entries.text: Time in seconds it takes to Grow.

entries.label: typeOfDeath
entries.text: Type of Death used. Valid values are: 0 = None, 1 = Explode, 2 = Fall, 3 = Burn, 4 = Collision Fall & Shot Burn.

entries.label: fallTime
entries.text:
Time in seconds it takes to Fall.
burnTime= 20.0f
Time in seconds it takes to Burn.

entries.label: hitRadius
entries.text: Hit Radius to trigger death. If -1 it uses ObjectSphere Height.

entries.label: bigFlame
entries.text: Flame Effect used for the Burn.

entries.label: darkRadius
entries.text: If this is > 0, the radius it Darkens the ground under it when placed.

entries.label: darkScale
entries.text: Multiplier for how much it darkens the ground under it.

entries.label: UseExplosionsOnFall
entries.text: If this is true, it reads and uses the following:

entries.label: hitGroundName
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used when this plant falls and hits the Ground.

entries.label: hitByCarName
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used when this plant is hit by a Vehicle.

entries.label: hitByBulletName
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used when this plant is hit by an Ordnance.

entries.label: smallFlame
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used to make rings of fire along the tree when it Burns.

entries.label: SwayingAmp
entries.text: Swaying Amplitude.

entries.label: SwayingFrec
entries.text: Swaying Frequency.

entries.label: SwayingDirX
entries.text: Swaying Direction on the X Axis.

entries.label: SwayingDirZ
entries.text: Swaying Direction on the Z Axis.

entries.label: Supported Animations:
entries.text: Deploy

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Powered buildings default to consuming 1 Power, and support a Deploy animation and Taps.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [GameObjectClass] powerCost = 1 buildRequire = "B" buildSupport = "B"

entries.label: powerName
entries.text: If specified, this is used as the powerName for all Taps not otherwise specified.

entries.label: powerTap1 … powerTap8
entries.text: Model piece name for this Tap object.

entries.label: powerName1 … powerName8
entries.text: The ODF name for each Tap object. Must be a GameObject Class. Default is powerName if not specified.

entries.label: AutoBuildTap1 … AutoBuildTap8

entries.label: detectRange

entries.label: PanelIcon
entries.text: If specified, this is the icon that is displayed in the Base Panel, if this object occupies a Base 1 - 9 slot.

entries.label: SoundSelect

entries.label: SoundDeselect
entries.text: Sound file played when this object is Deselected.

entries.label: SoundSwitchOn

entries.label: SoundSwitchOff
entries.text: Sound file played when this object is switched to Powered Off state.

entries.label: SoundTerminalSwitchOn
entries.text: Sound file played when this object's Terminal is activated.

entries.label: SoundTerminalSwitchOff
entries.text: Sound file played when this object's Terminal is deactivated.

entries.label: CanAlliesUse

entries.label: PauseAnimOnUnpowered

entries.label: ShowIcon

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Power Plants are Buildings that default to a powerCost of -3 for "powerplant" and -1 for "powerlung".

entries.text: [GameObjectClass] categoryTypeOverride = 15 // TEAM_SLOT_POWER buildRequire = "B" buildSupport = "B" powerCost = -3

entries.label: classlabel: "powerlung"

entries.label: DoBettyPower
entries.text: If this is false, won't give the Betty Voice Over for "Power Lost" (EVENT_SOUND_12) when this object is destroyed and Power goes negative.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Powerups are objects that can be picked up. They're also mobile and can be pushed by Explosion Kick or launched from an Armory.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [GameObjectClass] hitType = 3 // HIT_TYPE_VEHICLE canCollide = true boxCollide = false

entries.label: soundPickup
entries.text: Sound file played when Picked UIp. Default for is "repair.wav" for Class: ServicePowerup, and "weapon.wav" for Class: WeaponPowerup and MoneyPowerup.

entries.label: soundReject
entries.text: Sound file played when Rejected for Pickup.

entries.label: FLOAT_HEIGHT
entries.text: Height above the ground.

entries.label: LIFT_SPRING
entries.text: Lift Spring.

entries.label: LIFT_DAMP
entries.text: Lift Dampening.

entries.label: SlowFall
entries.text: If this is false, it uses FallSpeed for vertical fall speed.

entries.label: FallSpeed
entries.text: This is a limit on how fast it can Fall from Gravity. Only used if slowFall is false. If this is <= 0 it uses Forward/Reverse velocity.

entries.label: ExplodeEndOfLifespan
entries.text: If false, won't explode when lifeSpan is over. Only applies if GameObjectClass::LifeSpan is >= 0.

entries.label: HitMask
entries.text:
Bit Mask of which types of objects can accept this Powerup. If any of these bits are set to 0, an object of that type won't accept the Powerup. Valid values are:
1 : Craft
2 : Person
4 : Building
8 : PoweredBuilding
16 : Deployable
32 : Morphtank
64 : TurretCraft
128 : ServiceTruck
256 : TrackedVehicle
512 : Walker

entries.label: ExplodeOnBadHit
entries.text: If true, will Explode if an object tries to pick it up and is Rejected.

entries.label: DestroyOnBadHit
entries.text: If true, will be Destroyed (not Explode) if an object tries to pick it up and is Rejected.

entries.label: PowerupClassMask
entries.text: Bit Mask for use in comparison with GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch and GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides for filtering which objects can pick up this object.

entries.label: PowerupClassMatch
entries.text: Bit Mask for use in comparison with GameObjectClassPowerUpMask and GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides for filtering which objects can pick up this object.

entries.label: PowerupClassProvides
entries.text: Bit Mask for what this object Provides for use in comparison with GameObjectClassPowerUpMask and GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch for filtering which objects can pick up this object.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Scavenger is a special Tracked Vehicle that can Deploy into a building when it Deploys on top of a Deposit Class object. It can also pick up loose pieces of Scrap by driving over them and activating the Deploy function.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [GameObjectClass] categoryTypeOverride = 25 // TEAM_SLOT_SCAVENGER

entries.label: soundPickup
entries.text: Sound file played when this object picks up a piece of Scrap.

entries.label: scrapHold
entries.text:
How much Scrap this object holds. By default this is internal hold only, and does not add to the Scrap Bar. It transfers any scrap from it's hold that will fit into the Scrap Bar immediately.
If the Scrap Bar is full, it will continue to Scavenge until it's internal hold is full.

entries.label: deployClass
entries.text: The ODF of the object this vehicle turns into when Deployed onto a Deposit Class. Must be a valid GameObject Class.

entries.label: enablePoolGoTo
entries.text: If this is false, it won't do the point-space reticle action to go to a Deposit. It is also false if the DeployClass is invalid.

entries.label: deployOffset
entries.text: How far away it moves from the Center of the pool to start Deploying when entering the SLIDE state.

entries.label: doDrop
entries.text: If false, won't instantly transfer scrap to the Scrap Hold, but instead will return to the nearest valid Drop Off point, like BZ1/98R Scavengers.

entries.label: DropDist
entries.text: If doDrop is true, this is how far it must be from the Dropoff point to transfer it's Scrap Hold to the Scrap Bar.

entries.label: doDropRecycler
entries.text: If doDrop is true, sets if this object can Dropoff scrap at a Recycler.

entries.label: doDropExtractor
entries.text: If doDrop is true, sets if this object can Dropoff scrap at an Extractor.

entries.label: doDropSilo
entries.text: If doDrop is true, sets if this object can Dropoff scrap at a Silo.

entries.label: CanScavenge
entries.text: If false, can't pick up Loose Scrap.

entries.label: ScrapFirst
entries.text: If true, will collect visible loose scrap before deploying on a pool. If false, will deploy on any nearby pools first.

entries.label: IsFearless
entries.text: If false, will flee to nearest Allied building when shot.

entries.label: animPickup
entries.text: If specified, the animationName used when picking up a piece of Scrap.

entries.label: animPickupCycle
entries.text: The Animation Type of the pickup animation. 0 = Loop, 1 = Two way.

entries.label: DeathScrapDropRatio
entries.text: This is the ratio of current Scrap Hold that is dropped when this object dies. Max is 5.0

entries.label: AddScrapHoldToTotal
entries.text: If this is true, it's Scrap Hold is added to the Scrap Bar and it behaves more like a mobile Extractor.

entries.label: RequiresExtractor
entries.text: If true, requires a deployed Extractor for this object to generate Scrap. If false, will generate Scrap on it's own.

entries.text: If AddScrapHoldToTotal is true, this is the time in seconds before it starts generating Scrap.

entries.text: If AddScrapHoldToTotal is true, this is the time in seconds between generating 1 Scrap.

entries.label: ODF Properties:
entries.text: Depending on the Classlabel, one of these is used:

entries.label: healthUp
entries.text: How much Health it supplies. Default is 1000 for repairkit and servicepod.

entries.label: ammoUp
entries.text: How much Ammo it supplies. Default is 1000 for ammopack and servicepod.

entries.text: Ordnance push force at Center of field.

entries.label: ordPushEdge
entries.text: Ordnance push force at Edge of field.

entries.label: ordDragCenter
entries.text: Ordnance Drag at Center of field.

entries.label: ordDragEdge
entries.text: Ordnance Drag at Edge of field.

entries.label: ordDrag
entries.text:
OrdDragCenter.
If this is set, it is used for both ordDragCenter and ordDragEdge , and overrides those settings.

entries.label: TeamFilter
entries.text: Team Filter for what Teams to affect. Valid values are: 0 = all teams, 1 = same team only, 2 = allies, 3 = enemies

entries.label: ForceMass
entries.text: If this is < 0, default behavior is applied. If this is > 0, then the Force applied to the object is multiplied by (ForceMass / Target's Mass).

entries.label: MinForceMassScale
entries.text: If ForceMass is > 0, this is the minimum mass it clamps to.

entries.label: MaxForceMassScale
entries.text: If ForceMass is > 0, this is the maximum mass it clamps to.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Missile is an Ordnance that can apply it's own Thrust and home in on a Target.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10

entries.label: velocForward
entries.text: Forward velocity applied by Thrust.

entries.label: accelThrust
entries.text: Acceleration from Thrusting.

entries.label: delayTime
entries.text: Time in seconds before it begins homing.

entries.label: rampTime
entries.text: Time in seconds it takes to reach full homing turn speed.

entries.label: omegaTurn
entries.text: Turn speed.

entries.label: omegaWaver
entries.text: How much it's heading Wavers.

entries.label: rateWaver
entries.text: How fast it's heading Wavers.

entries.label: TeamFilter
entries.text: Team Fitler for choosing Targets. Used by LaserMissile and ThermalMissile. Valid values: 0 = all teams, 1 = same team only, 2 = allies, 3 = enemies, 4 = not same team

entries.label: avoidRange
entries.text: Range that it tries to Avoid obstacles such as Terrain.

entries.label: avoidStrength
entries.text: How much it Steers to avoid Terrain.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Popper is a Grenade that launches another Ordnance when it starts falling or it's lifeSpan expires.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10

entries.label: scanRange
entries.text: Range the Popper will search for Targets.

entries.label: TargetHidden
entries.text: If this is >= 0, it is used to check if the Popper targets MorphTanks with HiddenWhenMorphed while Deployed. 0 is false, 1 is true.

entries.label: TargetInteractable
entries.text: If this is >= 0, it is used to check if the Popper targets objects that are Interactable. 0 is false, 1 is true.

entries.label: TeamFilter
entries.text: Team Filter for what objects the Popper can Target. Valid values: 0 = all teams, 1 = same team only, 2 = allies, 3 = enemies, 4 = not same team

entries.label: launchOrd
entries.text: ODF name of the Ordnance Class launched by this Popper.

entries.label: launchXpl
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used when this ordnance launches it's launchOrd.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Pulse Shell is an Ordnance that emits an Explosion periodically. It can also pass through objects if it's shotRadius is negative.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10 lifeSpan = 1e30 shotSpeed = 50

entries.label: pulseDelay
entries.text: Time in seconds before it begins emitting Pulses.

entries.label: pulsePeriod
entries.text: Interval between Pulses.

entries.label: xplPulse
entries.text: ODF name for the Explosion Class emitted each Pulse.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Radar Missile is a missile that can't lock onto a Target that is using RadarDampen class. (Red Field)

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10 [MissileClass] omegaTurn = 1.0f

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Radar Popper is a Grenade that launches an Ordnance towards the owner's current Target as soon as it begins falling.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10

entries.label: launchOrd
entries.text: ODF name of the Ordnance Class launched by this Popper.

entries.label: launchXpl
entries.text: ODF name of the Explosion Class used when this ordnance launches it's launchOrd.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: SeismicWave generates a Wave across the Terrain that disorients objects in it's path.

entries.label: waveRadius
entries.text: Radius of the Wave.

entries.label: waveHeight
entries.text: Height of the Wave.

entries.label: waveFrontFrequency
entries.text: How much of the Wave front dips.

entries.label: rampUpTime
entries.text: Time in seconds until it reaches full Height.

entries.label: rampDownTime
entries.text: Time in seconds it takes to reduce height back to 0.

entries.label: sweepOmega
entries.text: Sweep rotational velocity to spin units as the wave moves past.

entries.label: sweepVeloc
entries.text: Sweep linear velocity to push units along with the wave.

entries.label: shakeFrequency
entries.text: The frequency of the noise used by the shake effect.

entries.label: shakeOmega
entries.text: Shake rotational velocity to spin units randomly.

entries.label: shakeVeloc
entries.text: Shake linear velocity to push units randomly.

entries.label: dampOmega
entries.text: Rotational damping force to keep units from spinning.

entries.label: levelOmega
entries.text: Rotational leveling force to keep units from flipping.

entries.label: buildingScale
entries.text: Multiplier applied to Damage done to Buildings.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Sniper Shell is an Ordnance that can kill the Pilot of a craft if it hits within a certain Radius and Distance of the hp_eyepoint dot.

entries.label: killLength
entries.text: How far into the mesh the sniper shell can penetrate.

entries.label: killRadius
entries.text: Radius of which it has to hit the Eyepoint dot to snipe.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Spray Bomb is a Grenade that turns into a GameObject when it lands and comes to a stop.

entries.label: payloadName
entries.text: ODF name of the GameObject Class this object turns into when it stops moving.

entries.label: bounceRatio
entries.text: Percent of Velocity retained after it bounces off the ground.

entries.label: soundBounce
entries.text: Sound file played when it bounces off the Ground / Buildings.

entries.label: HitExplodeTypes
entries.text:
If this is > 0, it is a Bit Mask for which types of objects it Detonates on. Valid values are:
1 = Building
2 = Craft
4 = Person
8 = Other
16 = Terrain

entries.label: BuildSprayOnHit
entries.text:
If this is false, it won't build payloadName when it hits a valid HitType.
Only applies if HitExplodeTypes is not 0.

entries.label: ExplodeOnHit
entries.text:
If true, will generate an Explosion Class when it hits a valid HitType.
Only applies if HitExplodeTypes is not 0.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Thermal Missile is a Missile that homes in on the Heat Signature of an object.

entries.label: Default ODF Properties:
entries.text: [OrdnanceClass] ammoCost = 10 [MissileClass] omegaTurn = 1.0f

entries.label: coneAngle
entries.text: The cone angle which it can lock onto Targets. This is in radians.

entries.label: lockRange
entries.text: Range which it can seek a target on it's own.

entries.label: ActLikeBZ2
entries.text: If true, can be distracted by any passing units, and loses it's target if it goes outside coneAngle. If false, prioritizes it's locked on Target (if any), and continues to track it even if it's outside the missile's coneAngle.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: Explosion Class is an instant Damage and Kick effect, with distance falloff.

entries.label: particleCount
entries.text:
Number of Particle Fx. Max is 16.
For each Particle Count:

entries.label: particleClass1 … particleClass16
entries.text: The Render Name for this Particle emitter.

entries.label: particlePosVar1 … particlePosVar16
entries.text: Particle starting Position variance.

entries.label: particleBias1 … particleBias16
entries.text: Particle base Velocity.

entries.label: particleVeloc1 … particleVeloc16
entries.text: Particle Velocity variance applied in addition to particleBias.

entries.label: particleInherit1 … particleInherit16
entries.text: Percent of Inherited velocity applied. 0.0 - 1.0 for each Axis.

entries.label: explSound
entries.text: Sound file played with this Explosion.

entries.label: damageRadius
entries.text: Radius that Damage is applied near this object.

entries.label: damageValue(N)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with no Shield and Armor class N.

entries.label: damageValue(L)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with no Shield and Armor class L.

entries.label: damageValue(H)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with no Shield and Armor class H.

entries.label: damageValue(S)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with Shield class S.

entries.label: damageValue(D)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with Shield class D.

entries.label: damageValue(A)
entries.text: Damage value done to objects with Shield class A.

entries.label: kickRadius
entries.text: Radius that Kick effect is applied.

entries.label: kickVeloc
entries.text: Kick Velocity applied to objects nearby.

entries.label: kickOmega
entries.text: Kick Omega applied to objects nearby.

entries.label: StartUpright
entries.text: If this is true, creates the Explosion oriented up. If false it generates it perpendicular to Terrain normal.

entries.label: FriendlyFireDamage
entries.text: If true, Friendly units can receive Damage from this Explosion.

entries.label: ChunkExplodeHeight
entries.text:
Height above the ground the Chunks must get before they Explode.
_Note_: Only used by Chunk Explosions.

entries.label: ChunkScrapValue
entries.text:
The amount of Scrap dropped by ChunkScrapClass1...3.
_Note_: Only used by Chunk Explosions.

entries.label: ChunkScrapClass1 … ChunkScrapClass3
entries.text:
If ChunkScrapValue is > 0, it chooses between these 3 classes of Scrap to drop.
_Note_: Only used by Chunk Explosions.

entries.label: Description:
entries.text: An Explosion Class that also launches Ordnance in a circle around it, and generates a Quake event.

entries.label: quakeCount
entries.text: How many Ordnance to generate.

entries.label: quakeClass
entries.text: ODF name of the Ordnance Class to emit.

entries.label: pitchVariance
entries.text: Variance in the vertical trajectory of the Ordnance.

entries.label: yawVariance
entries.text: Variance in the horizontal trajectory of the Ordnance.

entries.label: initialPitch
entries.text: Initial Pitch of the Ordnance trajectory.

entries.label: initialYaw
entries.text: Initial Yaw of the Ordnance trajectory.

entries.label: quakeMagnitude
entries.text: Magnitude of the Quake event.

entries.label: quakeTime
entries.text:
Time in seconds the Quake lasts.
in BZCC version 2.0.185 (current version), do not put a value of 0 in this field.
